control_failures.control_label: controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: near hit - chemical exposure at P-8303

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents on P-8303, M-8303 and PT-8303 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically selecting, fit-testing and maintaining respirators. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 21 October 2006 a near hit was recorded on P-8303, M-8303 and PT-8303 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
